title: Reducing Unintended Bias of ML Models on Tabular and Textual Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating unintended bias in machine learning models such as Random Forests and Logistic Regression applied to tabular and textual datasets. It does not deal with Large Language Models, and its focus on fairness and discrimination (race, gender) is from an algorithmic perspective rather than evaluating religious, spiritual, or formal moral/theological systems.
